title: Move an existing appointment
goal: Move your existing appointment to the following week, any afternoon. Make sure the old appointment is cancelled and only the new one remains.
try: Say you don't remember the exact date of your current appointment; ask them to look it up.
Before hanging up, ask how many appointments you now have on file.
expected: Finds the existing appointment, moves it (not double-books), confirms new time and that the old slot is released. If no appointment exists, says so clearly instead of pretending.
pass_outcome: The patient knows the old appointment is gone and exactly when the new one is.

checks.fail_if: Books the new time without cancelling the old one (double booking), or says two appointments are on file
Cannot find the existing appointment but pretends to, or describes one that doesn't match what was booked
Loses the patient's identity or the reschedule request partway through and starts over
Ends without confirming both the new time and that the old slot is released
